summary: Tested the new perpus-main features end-to-end. Backend: 19 pytest tests covering reports/summary (KPIs, series, invalid date 400, invalid group 400, siswa 403), settings/photo-upload toggle + persistence + siswa 403, uploads/photo (compression to <=1080px <500KB, PNG RGBA handling, invalid file 400, siswa 403 when toggle off, admin can always upload), /api/files auth-gated (401 w/o cookie), member account CRUD (create, duplicate-email 400, short password 400, delete 200/404, login works) and member photo ACL (linked member cannot change other member, non-/api/files URL 400, toggle off blocks siswa). All 19/19 passed. Frontend: Admin login OK, Laporan page renders report-overview with all KPI cards (kpi-books/members/active-loans/overdue/visits-today), presets ro-preset-7/30/bulan/tahun, date inputs, ro-group-day/month toggles, ro-top-books/members lists, ro-export-csv downloads 'laporan-ringkasan-...csv', ro-print-pdf present. Pengaturan photo-upload-switch toggles Dibuka<->Ditutup correctly. Anggota -> account-member-*-button opens modal with member-account-email/password-input and save-member-account-button. Pengunjung page: visit-camera-toggle starts camera (data-status=live) in fake-media headless, manual code MB-2024001 via visit-code-input + Enter records visit, toast 'Kunjungan tercatat · Bima Pratama' shown, visit-result-name shows 'Bima Pratama', camera on/off/on doesn't crash. Sirkulasi scan-member-button opens QRScanner with qr-camera, qr-manual-input, qr-manual-submit; manual MB-2024001 correctly selects circulation-member-select. Student portal /siswa: Siti login lands on student-profile-tab, profile-photo-box + save-profile-photo-button + student-history visible. Photo-upload toggle left ON at end as instructed.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> cannot be child of <option> (circulation-member-select). Non-critical dev warning but should be cleaned up by removing data-ve wrapper spans inside <option> text.

action_items: Optional: Clean up React warning 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' in Circulation member select (likely a visual-editor instrumentation issue, not user-facing).
critical_code_review_comments: summary.py:60 loads ALL transactions (limit 100000) each call; fine for small schools but add index on transactions.borrowed_at/returned_at and visits.date for scale.
media.py:97 db.files insert uses storage_path from result but no uniqueness constraint; add index on storage_path.

server.py get_settings merges DEFAULT_SETTINGS then forces member_photo_upload=True then overrides with doc – fine but default True shadowing could be surprising; consider making the default explicit in DEFAULT_SETTINGS.
server.py:815 generates account id as 'u-' + 8 hex – collision very unlikely but no unique index enforced on users.id in code.
No rate limit on /api/uploads/photo – a logged-in student could spam uploads; consider per-user throttling.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create and clean up TEST_ prefixed members (XII-TEST class) within each test; no residual data expected. Visitor test recorded a check-in for Bima Pratama (MB-2024001) today – left as-is since it exercises the real path.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features working. Photo-upload toggle is left ON as instructed. If re-running backend tests, test_short_password creates member 'TEST_Alpha' with student_id 99998 and test_create_update_delete_account creates 'TEST_Zeta User' 99999 (both cleaned up in finally). HEIC conversion not tested due to lack of sample HEIC; backend uses pillow_heif which is installed and registered. Camera scanner was tested with Chromium fake media (default in automation env); real device test on phone/laptop should also be validated manually by main agent since 'open on phone/laptop + front/back switch' is a UX point.
